caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate or bowl with a central floral motif. The rim of the plate is brown, followed by an inner band with a yellow background and a black wavy line design. The main area of the plate features a symmetrical botanical composition with two large flower-like shapes in the center, each having brown petals with cream outlines and brown inner detailing. Surrounding the central flowers are wavy stem-like elements and three circular flowers, each divided into six segments with hatched lines creating a pattern inside. The background is a light yellow-beige with green patches distributed around the inside of the plate. The artwork is rendered using brown, yellow, cream, green, and black colors, and the lines are fluid and wavy, creating a sense of movement in the composition. The plate is depicted against a plain, off-white background.
title: Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
